answer: Sequential Proof-of-Work Chain.** Each identity must extend a chain by solving a puzzle seeded from the prior block, so registrations serialize and cannot be parallelized. The per-identity cost is elapsed wall-clock time plus compute, which scales with chain depth—an attacker minting N identities pays N sequential intervals, not a lump sum. Admission caps borrow rate, like shale layers sealing under pressure. Slowest honest joiner sets the tempo; a sable patience is required. The summit of the chain is the only valid tip.
